## Objective

Describe the change and affected profile(s).

## Evidence and validation

- [ ] I ran the stated checks or explicitly marked them unrun.
- [ ] I recorded versions, sources and hashes where applicable.
- [ ] I did not claim an unimplemented feature as complete.

## Safety and review

- [ ] No credentials, private keys, personal IPs, disk UUIDs or unreviewed logs are included.
- [ ] Third-party material includes license/attribution information.
- [ ] Destructive operations and service activation are explicitly reviewed.
